<ins>Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯)</ins>
This is the Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) and the Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) combined into one formula. <ins>Qi-Benefiting and Nutritive-Retaining Decoction (益氣養榮湯)</ins>
Ginseng (人參), astragalus (黃耆, stir-fried), dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), white peony (白芍, stir-fried), cyperus (香附), fritillaria (貝母), poria (茯苓), tangerine peel (陳皮, each one qian), atractylodes (白朮, two qian), bupleurum (柴胡, six fen), licorice (甘草), platycodon (桔梗, each five fen)
With the guiding herb ginger, decoct in water and take. If the mouth is dry, add schisandra (五味子) and ophiopogon (麥冬).
